text:
alex_w: quick sync—i want to land a set of per-model+per-route perf panels in Console (P50/P95/P99 latency, TTFT, tokens/sec, request rate). main ask: what runtime labels/emit shape do you need so dashboards are useful across routing/fallbacks and dedicated/dyno?

maya_r: +1. sketching a proposal now. couple constraints: avoid high-cardinality labels in ingest, want stable rollups for SLIs.

kevin_p: need UX for route vs model views. product wants a single route page that can toggle model-variants and time windows. also show active routing policy at that time (canary/fallback).

elyse_pm: important for SLOs: link dashboard to rollout policies so we can see when fallback happened relative to latency spikes.

alex_w: here's the metric proto i'm proposing for the runtime to emit. please call out anything missing:
```
# summary metrics (aggregated, low-cardinality)
redwood.runtime.requests.count{model, route, env, region}  # per-second count
redwood.runtime.latency.p50_ms{model, route, env, region}
redwood.runtime.latency.p95_ms{model, route, env, region}
redwood.runtime.latency.p99_ms{model, route, env, region}
redwood.runtime.ttft.p50_ms{model, route, env, region}
redwood.runtime.tokens_per_sec.p50{model, route, env, region}

# optional labels: quant, variant, customer_tier (but watch cardinality)
```

maya_r: this looks fine. couple comments:
- rename `model` -> `model_id` to match existing emitters
- add `route_id` label (string stable id) in addition to human route path so dashboards can join to routing config
- suggest we emit `fallback_reason` as a sparse tag on sampled request traces only (not on every metric)

sre_jordan: from an SRE POV we need TTFT at p95+p99 for small/large seq buckets. maybe add `seq_bucket` (short enum: short, medium, long) rather than raw length to keep cardinality low.

kevin_p: UX note: console wants to offer prebuilt panels that rollup across model variants but also let users split by variant/quant. so we need stable `variant` label values and a mapping table in the Console that understands compatibility (e.g., gpt4o-8k-v1 -> gpt4o-8k-quantized).

alex_w: good call on `seq_bucket`. updated metric block: 
```
redwood.runtime.latency.p95_ms{model_id, route_id, env, region, seq_bucket}
redwood.runtime.ttft.p99_ms{model_id, route_id, env, region, seq_bucket}
redwood.runtime.tokens_per_sec.p50{model_id, route_id, env, region}
```

elyse_pm: for routing policy visibility: can the router emit events when it swaps route->variant (canary, fallback) with a timestamp and route_id, variant_from, variant_to? Console can correlate those events with metric spikes.

maya_r: yes. router already emits a small event stream. we'll add an `routing.change` event with {route_id, from_variant, to_variant, reason, timestamp}. we'll make it low-volume.

sre_jordan: sampling plan: full counts for requests and latency histograms at 100% for routes under X rps (configurable). for hot routes >X rps emit only aggregated p50/p95/p99 and sample 0.1% raw traces. set X at 50 rps by default.

alex_w: sounds reasonable. infra concern: ingestion must support cardinality of (model_id x route_id x region x seq_bucket). ops-team, can we cap `customer_tier` to 'free'|'paid'|'enterprise' as a rollup label rather than raw org id?

observability-bot: new ticket created: OBS-1234 "Emit per-model/route metrics proto + routing.change events" assigned to eng-runtime. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/OBS-1234

kevin_p: action items i see:
- runtime: emit metrics with labels: model_id, route_id, env, region, seq_bucket + routing.change events (maya)
- infra: validate ingest cardinality + storage/retention for p99 histograms (sre_jordan)
- console: create panel templates and join on route_id, show routing.change timeline (kevin + dashboard se)
- product: define default seq_bucket boundaries and X rps sampling threshold (elyse)

elyse_pm: i'll propose seq_bucket = {short: <256 tokens, medium: 256-2048, long: >2048} and X=50 rps.

maya_r: we'll spike on runtime side this week. expect PR with config and example emitter by EOD Friday.

alex_w: cheers. if no objections i'll merge the dashboard RFC into the backlog and tag owners. quick thumbs to confirm? :

kevin_p: +1
elyse_pm: +1
sre_jordan: +1
maya_r: +1

maya_r: summary (will paste into OBS-1234):
- metric names and labels agreed (model_id, route_id, env, region, seq_bucket)
- router emits routing.change events with reason
- sampling: full for routes <50 rps, aggregated-only for hot routes + 0.1% traces
- Console to provide two views: route-default rollup + variant split
- owners: runtime(maya), infra(sre_jordan), console(kevin), product(elyse)

alex_w: perfect — I'll add the owners to OBS-1234 and schedule a 30m handoff next Tue.

maya_r: thanks all :thumbsup:
